Definition: to be (or become) white; to make bricks
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be white; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to make white, become white, purify; 1a2) to show whiteness, grow white; 1b) (Hithpael) to become white, be purified (ethical); 2) (Qal) to make bricks
